annotations.title: How to write a faceless story video

description: AI Story Video: faceless narrated short videos for TikTok, Reels and Shorts in many formats: 'what if' explainers, body facts, history, scary stories, space, animals, how it works, mysteries, survival, myths, POV, storytime, would you rather, psychology, rise and fall, disasters, Bible stories, build it, cartoon stories and choose-your-path episodes. One narrator voice over AI pictures and clips, with captions and music. This returns every format with examples, the options with prices, and the exact prompts MakeViral's own writer gets for this format and length. You can write the whole script yourself (any model, in the user's own way) and pass it to check_story_video and start_story_video as `draft`; then MakeViral does not write it and does not charge for writing it. Without a script, start_story_video writes it from the idea.

continueFrom.description: Part 2 of a finished choose-your-path (or 'Part 2?') story of this user

choice.description: The option the viewers voted for (0-based)

format.description: The video format. Default what-if. story_video_guide lists them with examples.

idea.description: One line, e.g. 'What if the moon disappeared?'

quality.description: How many scenes move (AI clips) instead of stills. Default: the format's.

seconds.description: Length in seconds. Default: the format's.

story.description: The user's own full story, when there is one: the script keeps its events, names and facts

voiceId.description: Narrator voice id (story_video_guide). Default: the format's.
